summary.text: Doris Turner, a Democrat, represents the 48th District in the Illinois Senate; her office biography says she was appointed to the seat in February 2021.

paragraphs.text: According to the biography, she is a lifelong Springfield resident who previously served on the Springfield City Council and the Sangamon County Board.
The biography also says she worked for the State of Illinois for 33 years, 22 of them with the Illinois Department of Public Health.
